item.title: Mountain climber and explorer Don Scivley brings his story of adventure to the library
item.description: On Thursday, Feb. 26, at noon, we will welcome mountain climber and explorer, Don Scivley from Birmingham as he brings his story of adventure to our library.

item.title: Unearth Cahawba: An Introduction
item.description: You may know Old Cahawba as Alabama’s first capital, or as the “ghost town” you drive past on the way to somewhere else. My job is to make sure you never see it as “empty” again.

item.title: Ivey signs Child Predator Death Penalty Act into law
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey on Thursday, Feb. 12, signed the Child Predator Death Penalty Act. One of the governor’s top priorities this legislative session, the new law provides the strongest legal protection for Alabama’s children from child predators.

item.title: WWI Veteran brought the freedom fight home to Selma
item.description: U.S. Army First Lt. Charles Adams came home to Selma after bloody WWI battles determined to seek the same freedom for his people that he had fought for overseas.

item.title: Former Stillman student invites fellow Stillmanites to march together at Jubilee
item.description: For California native Sara Smith, the semester she attended Tuscaloosa’s Stillman College in 1965 was a transformative experience.

item.title: Selma community gathers to celebrate the Jackson House
item.description: The Selma and Dallas County community gathered on Thursday, Feb. 12, for a special Lunch at the Library to celebrate the book “The House by the Side of the Road” and the successful relocation of the historic Jackson House to the Henry Ford Museum in Dearborn, Michigan.

item.title: Several Jubilee events planned for the 61st anniversary of Bloody Sunday
item.description: Organizers for the Annual Bridge Crossing Jubilee and the Selma to Montgomery Foundation gathered at the foot of the Edmund Pettus Bridge on Friday, Feb. 13, to pull back the curtain on the 2026 commemoration.

item.title: 7 Best AI-Powered Accounts Payable Automation Software (2026 Shortlist)
item.description: AI in accounts payable pays off when routine work disappears: invoice data gets captured reliably, coding becomes more consistent, and exceptions land with the right owner before approvals stall.

item.title: A legacy of care: Health department room named for nursing pioneer Vera Booker
item.description: There was standing room only in the Community Room at the Dallas County Health Department on Friday, Feb. 13, as the Selma and Dallas County community gathered to celebrate a living legend, Vera Jenkins Booker.

item.title: Honoring the impact of Selma’s Sara Duncan
item.description: Despite her national historical significance, Sara J. Hatcher Duncan remains a relatively obscure figure in her hometown of Selma.
